scope: Proposition 6.4 (Uniform compact right inverse) of the manuscript “A finite-time singularity of Calabi flow on projective space” (preprints/A-finite-time-singularity-of-Calabi-flow-on-projective-space-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 352 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 486e9e5ff47e92a4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are β0, η0, CD > 0 such that, for 0 < β ≤ β0 and 0 < T ≤ η0β4, the operator P has a real invariant right inverse D : Yα → Xα with ∥D∥ ≤ CD. No initial value is prescribed for Df.
